author: Bob O'Donnell
title: This week's Tech.pinions podcast features Ben Bajarin and Bo
text:
This week's Tech.pinions podcast features Ben Bajarin and Bob O'Donnell discussing the major themes from this year's CES show, including the growth in robotics, the influence of AI and automation, the declining presence of Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), the rise in voice-based interfaces, and more.

Disclaimer: Some of the author's clients are vendors in the tech industry.
